_comment: Phase 25 COMPLIANCE-01 (D-03 / OQ#4) coverage ratchet baseline. Counts = number of shipped rules carrying a non-empty mapping per framework; total_rules = full denominator (ALL shipped rules, mapped or not). The release.yml coverage-regression gate FAILS if any framework count drops below these numbers. Bump these counts (commit) in the same PR that adds mappings so the ratchet only ever rises. 2026-06-02: +2 each framework + total 246->248 for Phase 8.5 DISCORD-01 (discord/library-verified + discord/missing-signature-verification, both mapped). 2026-06-02: +1 each framework + total 248->249 for Phase 8.3 Plan 16b (standardwebhooks/multi-signature-mishandled, mapped). 2026-10-09: +16 each framework + total 249->270 for the PayPal / Braintree / NMI provider packs (21 rules; the 5 unmapped ones mirror their templates: nmi timing-unsafe-comparison / wrong-hmac-algorithm / unreachable-verification like intercom, and both library-verified like square).
